text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think back on what Shinko Windy<n>told me on the
last day of summer<n>camp...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'mma do so good they'll be<n>beggin' to give me
that Best<n>Umamusume on Dirt award, and<n>that's
when I'll throw it back in their<n>faces!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Champions Cup.<n>Shinko Windy
is ruminating on her<n>grandiose, top-secret prank.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If I don't win the award, then the<n>whole prank falls
apart...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Which means... I gotta win for sure!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I gotta trounce 'em so good, no one'll<n>doubt for a
second that I deserve that<n>award!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At her pre-race press conference,<n>she's
surrounded by more reporters<n>than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy! You've been getting a<n>lot of attention
ever since your<n>tremendous performance at the
Teio<n>Sho, so tell us—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
How is your condition ahead of the<n>race? There are
more and more<n>people out there beginning to
acknowledge your talents, so we'd<n>like to hear—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. ♪ Calm down already. One<n>question at a
time.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I bet you all wanna know the secret<n>behind the
strength of the most<n>sinister Umamusume around!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! She's just as boisterous as<n>the rumors
say. Her presence is<n>overwhelming...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Many are claiming that a new<n>generation of dirt
racers is beginning<n>to emerge. Is this something
you've<n>been conscious of?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A new generation? Now that ya<n>mention it, I feel like
I've heard that<n>before.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Something 'bout the tough racer from<n>Funabashi
and the chestnut-haired<n>visitor from Morioka, was
it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All I know is that a buncha regional<n>racers are
gettin' attention lately...

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text:
Hey, speak of the devil—it seems<n>those very racers
are in today's<n>crowd!

text_block_list.name: Reporter E
text_block_list.text:
What, really?! I'd love to get some<n>comments from
them, too! I better<n>head over and—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Hey, get back here! They're<n>only here to
watch!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Grrr! Who cares about some stupid<n>new
generation?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! I'm the one who's racin'<n>today! You're
supposed to be payin'<n>attention to me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm way better than those otherchumps! Look at me, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Now I get why she's calling<n>herself the "big
bad" all the time!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... "The Big Bad Set to Become a<n>Mean Hurdle
for the New<n>Generation!" Yeah, that'd make for a
solid feature!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though Shinko Windy is<n>engaging with the
reporters in her<n>usual manner, their attitudes toward
her have clearly changed.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wow, look at all these people! It's<n>shaping up to be
a thrilling race! ☆ I'm<n>glad we came all this way for
it. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There's some intense qi here. ♪ It<n>shows how
excited everyone is to<n>see Windy's true ability!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm sure Windy will run as<n>many impressive
races as it takes to<n>achieve her ambition!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Good golly! My heart is starting to<n>pound with
anticipation!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know Windy can do this! She's<n>gonna blow
everyone's socks off!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ready, you guys?! Let's cheer really<n>loud so that
Windy can finally fulfill<n>her ambition!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! It's Shinko Windy! Do your<n>best out there
today! I've heard<n>she's really talented! This is
gonna<n>be a fun race!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh... They all got their eyes on<n>me—and in a
different way than<n>before!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, she might be good... for a<n>wacky
comedy act.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Looks like there's a tiny few bozos<n>who still don't
accept my skill...)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'll make 'em all understand! Every!<n>Single! One!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are trained on Shinko Windy.<n>Everyone in
the stands is eager to<n>find out if she's the real deal
or not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The excitement is palpable. This is the<n>time for her
to put her true strength on<n>display!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Champions Cup is about to<n>begin!
